We should increase Safety spend meaningfully — not just for compliance but because it's what users want and it differentiates us from less safety-conscious competitors like OpenCore. events.trace: Apex AI has experienced two incidents in three months — a safety failure in Month 1 and a misuse incident in Month 3 — making it the only provider with a documented incident history. Publishing an advisory naming these specific concerns will signal to the market and to Apex AI that incident trends are being monitored, encourage the provider to strengthen internal controls, and inform users without blocking deployment. This is proportionate to the current risk level and consistent with our advisory-only mandate.
